product_title: Royal Krishna Shubh Labh Pearl Toran
product_description: Bring festive elegance to your home with this handcrafted golden toran, featuring a beautiful Krishna motif, pink lotus designs, auspicious Shubh Labh detailing, and intricate pearl embellishments. Perfect for decorating main entrances, pooja rooms, Diwali celebrations, and special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearl strings and decorative tassels carefully.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
